note: This project's real AC tests are prefixed per PRD (tests/<test_prefix>_ac<NN>_*.rs), NOT the tests/acceptance_<id>.rs the scaffold template generates. scripts/run-metrics.sh carries a project-local fallback (see its 'PROJECT_AC_FILES' section) so the harness's ac_passing_count/ac_total_count scalars count these real files instead of reporting 0.
ac_test_map_contract: ac_test_map is the AC-to-test mapping for the PRD CURRENTLY BUILDING AT HEAD -- not a repo-lifetime constant. scripts/intent-card-refresh.sh (build skill) is its only consumer: it fills agent/intent-card.json's acceptance_criteria[].test from this flat dict by bare AC number. Every PRD in this repo numbers its own ACs from 1, so a map left frozen at an earlier PRD silently re-binds the new PRD's ACs to the older PRD's tests -- the card then claims proof from files that prove something else. That defect was flagged by reviewer-agent and 'fixed in place' at least three times (see agent/intent-card.json ambiguities_resolved: 2026-09-12 'intent-card-ac-test-field-stale-pointers', and 2026-09-17 'ac-test-field-pointers-semantically-wrong') without ever touching this file, which is why it kept recurring. A rust-extend dispatch that adds tests/<prefix>_ac*.rs files MUST update ac_test_map to its own PRD's ACs before the pre-gate intent-card refresh runs, and archive its predecessor under ac_test_map_by_prefix below so nothing is lost.
